name: Nella Networks
summary: Melbourne ISP; HoloHost (under Beretvale Pty Ltd) became Nella Networks, then Nella Telecommunications after separating from Beretvale; took over Intervision customers (2002); clients merged into Bordernet Oct 2004.

events.details: Evolved from HoloHost under Beretvale Pty Ltd.
ISP clients merged into Bordernet; entity wound up 2008.
